final: SELECT AVG(gender_order_count) AS average_gender_order_count, AVG(gender_order_count - overall_average) AS average_excess FROM (SELECT gender, COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS gender_order_count, AVG(COUNT(DISTINCT order_id)) OVER () AS overall_average FROM Invoices JOIN Orders USING (order_id) JOIN Customers USING (customer_id) GROUP BY gender) WHERE gender_order_count > overall_average
